about_the_game:
Game of Planets is a persistent-online 4X MMORTS where every choice reverberates across a living galaxy of 1 600+ star systems and 10 000+ planets. Start with a single colony, then Explore, Expand, Exploit, Exterminate in real time against thousands of other commanders.

⚙️ Key Features

  • Planet-scale logistics – route fleets, resources, and population across a vast starmap while cosmic events keep you on your toes.

  • Deep technology web – unlock terra-forming, new ship types, and planet-cracking weapons; no fixed research path.

  • Diplomacy & intrigue – forge alliances, sign research pacts, enforce blockades, or back-stab rivals in a player-driven political layer.

  • Dynamic cosmic phenomena – meteor storms, rogue comets, and other random events reshape trade routes and battle plans, rewarding commanders who can adapt on the fly.

  • Customisable races & fleets – mix ship hulls, modules, and cultural perks to fit your grand strategy.

  • Community at the core – in-game messages and an active Discord power treaties, lore events, and dev-roadmap votes.

Shape the fate of civilisation—or watch it implode—when your next decision tips the balance of the galaxy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 @ 3.1 GHz or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or NVIDIA GT 730 (DirectX 11)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard & mouse required; always-online for MMO features.
